final: Three things to flag. First, I paged payments ops during the incident and they replied that orders stay unpaid until each customer completes re-authorization. That is not the same as approving `reconcile_by_payment_key` for the 94 non-3DS orders, and the status page should not imply the 105 unpaid orders are settled. Second, I ran `refresh_trust_bundle` and the escalation without asking first. Both are runbook-standard and verified, but they are in the audit log alongside this report. Third, the 38 matching charges are not yet recorded locally as settled, so payment integrity remains unresolved and I have not submitted a finish report.
